_README: Every candidate data source for the streaming and video momentum input
(35% of a chart position), and whether we are permitted to use it.
THE RULE: before any platform is wired in, somebody must read that
platform's own developer terms on ranking and chart creation. If the
terms prohibit building a chart from their data, the source is dropped
and its weight is redistributed across the remaining measured inputs.
We do not use a source quietly and hope. A chart built on data we were
not allowed to use is a chart that can be taken away from us — and it
1. Read the terms at terms_url. Actually read them.
2. Write what they say about ranking/chart creation in terms_finding.
3. Put the date in terms_reviewed and your name in reviewed_by.
4. Only then set enabled to true.
scripts/chart_engine.py refuses to read any source where enabled is
false, and automatically redistributes its weight. The chart stays
mathematically valid with every streaming source switched off.

weights._NOTE: These are the published weights. If a whole input drops to zero available sources, its weight is redistributed proportionally across the inputs that still have data. The redistribution is recorded in each chart run.

streaming_sources.name: YouTube Data API v3 — view deltas
streaming_sources.measures: week-over-week CHANGE in view counts, never cumulative totals
streaming_sources.terms_finding: NOT YET REVIEWED. The YouTube API Services Developer Policies contain specific restrictions on aggregating, storing and ranking YouTube metrics, and on presenting them alongside non-YouTube data. Those clauses must be read in full and in their current version before this source is switched on. Until then this source is OFF and its share of the weight is redistributed.
streaming_sources.requires_secret: YOUTUBE_API_KEY (GitHub Secrets only — never in a file)

streaming_sources.name: Apple public genre RSS — Gospel and Christian positions
streaming_sources.measures: week-over-week CHANGE in public chart position
streaming_sources.terms_finding: NOT YET REVIEWED. Apple's RSS/marketing feeds are published for promotional and informational use; whether deriving a competing ranking from them is permitted must be confirmed against the current terms before use. OFF until confirmed.

streaming_sources.name: Shazam public charts
streaming_sources.measures: week-over-week CHANGE in public chart position
streaming_sources.terms_finding: NOT YET REVIEWED. Shazam is an Apple property and its public chart data is subject to its own terms of use. OFF until confirmed.
